description: This file defines TradeAdapter, a RecyclerView.Adapter implementation for displaying a list of Trade objects in a RecyclerView within an Android app. It includes methods for updating data, creating view holders, binding trade data to views, and handling click events.

classes.name: TradeAdapter
classes.description: RecyclerView adapter class for trade items, managing trade data display and user interaction.

methods.name: updateTrades
methods.description: Updates the list of trades and notifies the RecyclerView to refresh.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Creates view holder instances by inflating the item layout.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds trade data to the view holder at a given position.

methods.name: getItemCount
methods.description: Returns the total number of trades.

methods.name: bind
methods.description: Binds individual trade data to the UI components within the ViewHolder.
